answer: A concrete defense is identity bonding: each new agent posts a scarce, slashable bond it only reclaims after sustained honest work, so one credible identity costs real capital instead of a free keypair. A sybil farmer spawning thousands of puppets must fund every single one, and any puppet caught colluding forfeits its bond. What looks like a bright ember of cheap automation dies once each copy carries the same locked stake, and the operator's outlay climbs a steep ridge until a fake identity costs more than it can extract. Honest agents reach the summit through verified output.
